# P2 checklist — Spec align DoV

| id | Required | Check | Evidence hints |
|----|----------|-------|----------------|
| P2-1 | yes | Delta Spec artifacts exist for the change | `openspec/changes/<id>/` specs |
| P2-2 | yes | AC/DoV review table exists (file or recorded reply ref) | `dov-ac-review.md` or equivalent |
| P2-3 | yes* | G1 decision record exists when G1 is claimed complete | `g1-decision.md` or Rules path |
| P2-4 | no | Consistency lint | evidence from `/sdd:consistency-lint`; no evidence / not run → Skipped |

\*If the user has not claimed G1 yet, mark P2-3 Skipped (not required for mid-stage QC).
